order_skus AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        s.sku_code
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE st.store_name = 'Shopify-DE-21'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
bom AS (
    SELECT
        os.order_id,
        os.order_date,
        os.line_qty,
        os.sku_code AS node_code,
        'sku' AS node_kind,
        1::BIGINT AS qty_mult
    FROM order_skus os

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.order_id,
        b.order_date,
        b.line_qty,
        c.child_code AS node_code,
        c.child_kind AS node_kind,
        (b.qty_mult * c.qty)::BIGINT AS qty_mult
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = b.node_kind
     AND c.parent_code = b.node_code
     AND c.valid_from <= b.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR b.order_date <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.line_qty * b.qty_mult), 0)::BIGINT AS units_consumed
FROM bom b
WHERE b.node_kind = 'component'
  AND b.node_code = 'CAB-563-BLK-01890';

WITH filtered_lines AS (
    SELECT l.sku_id, ol.qty, o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'DE'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
non_bundle_model_units AS (
    SELECT c.child_code AS model_code,
           SUM(fl.qty * c.qty) AS units
    FROM filtered_lines fl
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON sku.sku_id = fl.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND c.parent_code = sku.sku_code
     AND c.child_kind = 'model'
     AND c.valid_from <= fl.order_date
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR fl.order_date <= c.valid_to)
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
    GROUP BY c.child_code
),
bundle_model_units AS (
    SELECT item_model.child_code AS model_code,
           SUM(fl.qty * bundle_item.qty * item_model.qty) AS units
    FROM filtered_lines fl
    JOIN sales_sku bundle_sku ON bundle_sku.sku_id = fl.sku_id
    JOIN u_composition bundle_item
      ON bundle_item.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND bundle_item.parent_code = bundle_sku.sku_code
     AND bundle_item.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND bundle_item.valid_from <= fl.order_date
     AND (bundle_item.valid_to IS NULL OR fl.order_date <= bundle_item.valid_to)
    JOIN sales_sku item_sku
      ON item_sku.sku_code = bundle_item.child_code
    JOIN u_composition item_model
      ON item_model.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND item_model.parent_code = item_sku.sku_code
     AND item_model.child_kind = 'model'
     AND item_model.valid_from <= fl.order_date
     AND (item_model.valid_to IS NULL OR fl.order_date <= item_model.valid_to)
    WHERE bundle_sku.is_bundle = true
    GROUP BY item_model.child_code
),
combined AS (
    SELECT model_code, units FROM non_bundle_model_units
    UNION ALL
    SELECT model_code, units FROM bundle_model_units
)
SELECT model_code
FROM (
    SELECT model_code, SUM(units) AS total_units
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY model_code
) t
ORDER BY total_units DESC, model_code ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH RECURSIVE sold_skus AS (

        ol.qty AS multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id

    SELECT

        c.child_code,
        e.multiplier * c.qty,
        e.depth + 1

    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND c.parent_code = e.sku_code
     AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
     AND c.valid_from <= e.order_date
